blocks.text: It was supposed to be just another normal day, but one strange morning changed everything I knew about the world.
blocks.cachedSig: It was supposed to be just another normal day, but one strange morning changed everything I knew about the world.__blend_adam_onyx__am_adam:0.65,am_onyx:0.35__0.90__1.00

blocks.text: Hi, I am Mark, and I live in an old radio observatory high up in the mountains, far away from the chaos of the city.
blocks.cachedSig: Hi, I am Mark, and I live in an old radio observatory high up in the mountains, far away from the chaos of the city.__blend_adam_onyx__am_adam:0.65,am_onyx:0.35__0.90__1.00

blocks.text: I always thought being isolated was a good thing... until one morning, at exactly six fourteen, the sun never rose.
blocks.cachedSig: I always thought being isolated was a good thing... until one morning, at exactly six fourteen, the sun never rose.__blend_adam_onyx__am_adam:0.65,am_onyx:0.35__0.90__1.00

blocks.text: And that is when everything started to go wrong.
blocks.cachedSig: And that is when everything started to go wrong.__blend_adam_onyx__am_adam:0.65,am_onyx:0.35__0.90__1.00

blocks.text: At six fourteen in the morning, the sun failed to rise.
blocks.cachedSig: At six fourteen in the morning, the sun failed to rise.__blend_adam_onyx__am_adam:0.65,am_onyx:0.35__0.90__1.00

blocks.text: The first thing that disappeared was the birdsong.
blocks.cachedSig: The first thing that disappeared was the birdsong.__blend_adam_onyx__am_adam:0.65,am_onyx:0.35__0.90__1.00

blocks.text: I remember that because I had been awake all night, listening to the wind scrape against the observatory rusted antenna.
blocks.cachedSig: I remember that because I had been awake all night, listening to the wind scrape against the observatory rusted antenna.__blend_adam_onyx__am_adam:0.65,am_onyx:0.35__0.90__1.00

blocks.text: The mountain was usually full of noise before sunrise... birds, insects, distant trucks grinding up the valley road. At six thirteen, all of it stopped.
blocks.cachedSig: The mountain was usually full of noise before sunrise... birds, insects, distant trucks grinding up the valley road. At six thirteen, all of it stopped.__blend_adam_onyx__am_adam:0.65,am_onyx:0.35__0.90__1.00

blocks.text: I checked the clock above the radio desk. Six fourteen.
blocks.cachedSig: I checked the clock above the radio desk. Six fourteen.__blend_adam_onyx__am_adam:0.65,am_onyx:0.35__0.90__1.00

blocks.text: The eastern horizon was supposed to turn orange in six minutes.
blocks.cachedSig: The eastern horizon was supposed to turn orange in six minutes.__blend_adam_onyx__am_adam:0.65,am_onyx:0.35__0.90__1.00

blocks.text: Instead, something black spilled over the mountains. It didn't roll like fog. It climbed.
blocks.cachedSig: Instead, something black spilled over the mountains. It didn't roll like fog. It climbed.__blend_adam_onyx__am_adam:0.65,am_onyx:0.35__0.90__1.00

blocks.text: A thick, ash-colored darkness poured down the slopes and swallowed the pine trees one row at a time. It moved against the wind.
blocks.cachedSig: A thick, ash-colored darkness poured down the slopes and swallowed the pine trees one row at a time. It moved against the wind.__blend_adam_onyx__am_adam:0.65,am_onyx:0.35__0.90__1.00

blocks.text: It flowed around boulders, over rooftops, through the narrow streets of the city below.
blocks.cachedSig: It flowed around boulders, over rooftops, through the narrow streets of the city below.__blend_adam_onyx__am_adam:0.65,am_onyx:0.35__0.90__1.00

blocks.text: Then every streetlight in the valley went out simultaneously.
blocks.cachedSig: Then every streetlight in the valley went out simultaneously.__blend_adam_onyx__am_adam:0.65,am_onyx:0.35__0.90__1.00

blocks.text: I watched the city vanish behind the glass.
blocks.cachedSig: I watched the city vanish behind the glass.__blend_adam_onyx__am_adam:0.65,am_onyx:0.35__0.90__1.00

blocks.text: For one stupid moment, I thought it was a power cut.
blocks.cachedSig: For one stupid moment, I thought it was a power cut.__blend_adam_onyx__am_adam:0.65,am_onyx:0.35__0.90__1.00

blocks.text: Then the radio screamed.
blocks.cachedSig: Then the radio screamed.__am_fenrir____0.96__1.10

blocks.text: Every frequency, every channel, every station collapsed into a single low tone that vibrated through the desk and into my teeth.
blocks.cachedSig: Every frequency, every channel, every station collapsed into a single low tone that vibrated through the desk and into my teeth.__blend_adam_onyx__am_adam:0.65,am_onyx:0.35__0.90__1.00

blocks.text: The observatory's digital clocks blinked. My mobile phone went black.
blocks.cachedSig: The observatory's digital clocks blinked. My mobile phone went black.__blend_adam_onyx__am_adam:0.65,am_onyx:0.35__0.90__1.00

blocks.text: The diesel generator coughed once and stopped.
blocks.cachedSig: The diesel generator coughed once and stopped.__blend_adam_onyx__am_adam:0.65,am_onyx:0.35__0.90__1.00

blocks.text: Outside, somewhere below the mountain, a woman began screaming. She screamed for eleven seconds.
blocks.cachedSig: Outside, somewhere below the mountain, a woman began screaming. She screamed for eleven seconds.__am_fenrir____0.96__1.10

blocks.text: Then she said, in a perfectly calm voice:
blocks.cachedSig: Then she said, in a perfectly calm voice:__blend_adam_onyx__am_adam:0.65,am_onyx:0.35__0.90__1.00

blocks.text: Yes, Of course..
blocks.cachedSig: Yes, Of course..__af_heart____0.72__0.50

blocks.text: I didn't see her again. I spent the next thirty minutes trying to call the city. No network. No emergency lines. No internet.
blocks.cachedSig: I didn't see her again. I spent the next thirty minutes trying to call the city. No network. No emergency lines. No internet.__blend_adam_onyx__am_adam:0.65,am_onyx:0.35__0.90__1.00

blocks.text: I tried the observatory landline, which had been disconnected for years. It rang. I dropped it. It rang again.
blocks.cachedSig: I tried the observatory landline, which had been disconnected for years. It rang. I dropped it. It rang again.__blend_adam_onyx__am_adam:0.65,am_onyx:0.35__0.90__0.50

blocks.text: On the fourth ring, someone answered. A little boy whispered,
blocks.cachedSig: On the fourth ring, someone answered. A little boy whispered,__blend_adam_onyx__am_adam:0.65,am_onyx:0.35__0.90__1.00

blocks.text: Why did you leave us outside?
blocks.cachedSig: Why did you leave us outside?__af_river____0.78__0.70

blocks.text: Then the line went dead. I was alone in a radio observatory built in nineteen sixty-eight, three kilometers above the nearest town.
blocks.cachedSig: Then the line went dead. I was alone in a radio observatory built in nineteen sixty-eight, three kilometers above the nearest town.__blend_adam_onyx__am_adam:0.65,am_onyx:0.35__0.90__1.00

blocks.text: I had thirty days of emergency rations, two car batteries, a hand-cranked receiver, a telescope, a few flashlights, and a diesel generator with a questionable fuel reserve.
blocks.cachedSig: I had thirty days of emergency rations, two car batteries, a hand-cranked receiver, a telescope, a few flashlights, and a diesel generator with a questionable fuel reserve.__blend_adam_onyx__am_adam:0.65,am_onyx:0.35__0.90__1.00

blocks.text: I had always considered myself fortunate to work somewhere remote.
blocks.cachedSig: I had always considered myself fortunate to work somewhere remote.__blend_adam_onyx__am_adam:0.65,am_onyx:0.35__0.90__1.00

blocks.text: By the end of the first day, I understood that remoteness was not the same thing as safety.
blocks.cachedSig: By the end of the first day, I understood that remoteness was not the same thing as safety.__blend_adam_onyx__am_adam:0.65,am_onyx:0.35__0.90__1.00

blocks.text: And by the end of the first week, I would understand that the fog wasn't trying to get inside.
blocks.cachedSig: And by the end of the first week, I would understand that the fog wasn't trying to get inside.__blend_adam_onyx__am_adam:0.65,am_onyx:0.35__0.90__1.00

blocks.text: It was trying to get me to open the door.
blocks.cachedSig: It was trying to get me to open the door.__blend_adam_onyx__am_adam:0.65,am_onyx:0.35__0.90__1.00
